3478876886.detail_text: Sony MDR-ZX110AP Wired On-Ear Headphones Cross-Border Product Description Product Overview Upgrade your daily audio experience with the authentic Sony MDR-ZX110AP closed-back wired on-ear headphones, a cost-effective daily audio staple tailored for global users including students, office workers, commuters and casual music lovers. Designed by Sony professional audio team, this entry-level headphone balances premium sound quality, all-day wearing comfort, ultra-portable folding structure and practical hands-free calling function. Compatible with mainstream smartphones, tablets, laptops, MP3 players and game consoles with 3.5mm audio jack, it delivers stable lossless wired audio without Bluetooth latency, battery charging trouble or signal disconnection. Available in classic black, minimalist white and trendy navy multi-color options, it fits daily commuting, office online meeting, home leisure study, gaming voice chat and outdoor travel multi-scene use, ideal for cross-border daily audio essential picks with reliable Sony original quality and long-lasting service life. Immersive Balanced Audio Powered by 30mm Neodymium Dynamic Drivers Equipped with customized 30mm high-efficiency neodymium dynamic dome drivers, the Sony MDR-ZX110AP restores layered, high-fidelity stereo sound for all music genres. Built with high-density PET sensitive diaphragm, the headphone realizes smooth frequency response ranging from 12Hz to 22kHz, covering deep bass, clear mid vocal and crisp treble details. Optimized closed-back acoustic cavity structure effectively isolates external ambient noise without full ear pressure, enhancing bass resonance greatly. Whether you listen to pop, hip-hop, classical music, podcast, audiobook or watch streaming movies, TV shows and online videos, it presents pure audio details, subtle vocal breath and instrument timbre that cheap generic headphones cannot restore. With 24Ω rated impedance and 98dB/mW high sound sensitivity, it supports direct drive by mobile phones and laptops, no extra audio amplifier required, delivering loud, distortion-free sound even at high volume for effortless daily listening. Lightweight Ergonomic All-Day Comfort Wearing Design Weighing only 120g ultra-light whole machine weight, this Sony wired headphone reduces head top compression burden drastically compared with bulky over-ear headsets. Adopting upgraded elastic adjustable head beam, it fits head circumferences of teenagers, adults and large head sizes flexibly, with non-slip pressure-reducing top cushion to avoid forehead clamping pain during long-time wear. Skin-friendly breathable soft foam ear pads feature skin-touch matte leather surface, fitting ear contour perfectly to relieve ear heat and soreness after 4-6 hours continuous use, perfect for long-hour online class, remote office meeting, marathon drama watching and long-distance travel riding. The ergonomic on-ear structure will not squeeze eyeglass temples, friendly to glasses wearers for all-day comfortable wearing experience. Swivel Folding Portable Structure For Global Travel & Storage Built with upgraded 180° swivel flat-folding earcup mechanism, the MDR-ZX110AP can be folded into compact mini size easily, saving over 60% storage space compared with non-folding headphones. The rotatable ear cups adapt to different wearing angles, also enabling single-ear monitoring use for commuter road safety. Reinforced durable plastic hinge passes thousands of folding endurance tests, avoiding breakage and looseness during frequent carrying. Comes with 1.2m tangle-free flat audio cord, the optimized cord length fits desktop office, outdoor walking, subway commuting and bedroom leisure use, neither too short to limit movement nor too long to knot randomly. Easy to put into backpacks, handbags, laptop bags and school pencil cases, ultra-portable for business trips, campus daily use, overseas travel and outdoor outing anytime anywhere. Built-in Omnidirectional Mic & In-Line Remote For Clear Hands-Free Calls Different from basic music-only headphones, the Sony MDR-ZX110AP adds integrated omnidirectional electret condenser microphone and one-key in-line control module, realizing multifunctional one-handed operation. The upgraded noise-reduction pickup mic filters background wind noise, street noise and ambient chatter effectively, ensuring clear voice transmission for online team meetings, video calls, family voice chat and game team voice communication. The intuitive in-line control button supports one-key answer/hang up calls, play/pause audio, switch previous/next track quickly without touching your mobile device. Fully compatible with Android, iOS, Windows and MacOS mainstream systems, plug-and-play without extra driver installation, stable call performance for daily work communication and social contact. Universal 3.5mm Plug & Wide Device Compatibility Featured standard gold-plated 3.5mm TRS audio plug, anti-oxidation and anti-signal-interference design ensures stable audio transmission, reducing plug and play noise and sound interruption. Wide compatibility covers almost all 3.5mm audio port devices: iPhone old models, Android smartphones, iPad, tablet, Windows/Mac laptop, desktop computer, Switch game console, MP3, desktop audio and car audio system. Pure wired connection zero audio latency, superior to Bluetooth headsets for real-time game sound effect synchronization and video audio matching, no Bluetooth pairing failure, no periodic disconnection, no frequent charging troubles, zero-use-threshold for elders, kids and novice users. Sony Premium Durable Build & Multi-Color Aesthetic Design Adopting scratch-resistant matte anti-fingerprint body material, the headphone shell resists daily scratch, sweat corrosion and dust stain, keeping new appearance for long-term use. Reinforced cord junction enhances anti-breaking performance, solving common wire fracture problem of budget headphones. Minimalist classic Sony industrial design matches modern daily dressing style, three mainstream colorways: matte black for business office, pure white for youthful campus, dark blue for casual outdoor use, meeting personalized aesthetic demand of global young buyers. Humanized upgrade details: pressure balance head beam, soft buffer ear support, anti-tangle flat wire, all optimized for long-term daily household durable use. Sony MDR-ZX110AP Wired On-Ear Headphones Cross-Border Product Description

Product Overview

Upgrade your daily audio experience with the authentic Sony MDR-ZX110AP closed-back wired on-ear headphones, a cost-effective daily audio staple tailored for global users including students, office workers, commuters and casual music lovers. Designed by Sony professional audio team, this entry-level headphone balances premium sound quality, all-day wearing comfort, ultra-portable folding structure and practical hands-free calling function. Compatible with mainstream smartphones, tablets, laptops, MP3 players and game consoles with 3.5mm audio jack, it delivers stable lossless wired audio without Bluetooth latency, battery charging trouble or signal disconnection. Available in classic black, minimalist white and trendy navy multi-color options, it fits daily commuting, office online meeting, home leisure study, gaming voice chat and outdoor travel multi-scene use, ideal for cross-border daily audio essential picks with reliable Sony original quality and long-lasting service life.

Immersive Balanced Audio Powered by 30mm Neodymium Dynamic Drivers

Equipped with customized 30mm high-efficiency neodymium dynamic dome drivers, the Sony MDR-ZX110AP restores layered, high-fidelity stereo sound for all music genres. Built with high-density PET sensitive diaphragm, the headphone realizes smooth frequency response ranging from 12Hz to 22kHz, covering deep bass, clear mid vocal and crisp treble details. Optimized closed-back acoustic cavity structure effectively isolates external ambient noise without full ear pressure, enhancing bass resonance greatly. Whether you listen to pop, hip-hop, classical music, podcast, audiobook or watch streaming movies, TV shows and online videos, it presents pure audio details, subtle vocal breath and instrument timbre that cheap generic headphones cannot restore. With 24Ω rated impedance and 98dB/mW high sound sensitivity, it supports direct drive by mobile phones and laptops, no extra audio amplifier required, delivering loud, distortion-free sound even at high volume for effortless daily listening.

Lightweight Ergonomic All-Day Comfort Wearing Design

Weighing only 120g ultra-light whole machine weight, this Sony wired headphone reduces head top compression burden drastically compared with bulky over-ear headsets. Adopting upgraded elastic adjustable head beam, it fits head circumferences of teenagers, adults and large head sizes flexibly, with non-slip pressure-reducing top cushion to avoid forehead clamping pain during long-time wear. Skin-friendly breathable soft foam ear pads feature skin-touch matte leather surface, fitting ear contour perfectly to relieve ear heat and soreness after 4-6 hours continuous use, perfect for long-hour online class, remote office meeting, marathon drama watching and long-distance travel riding. The ergonomic on-ear structure will not squeeze eyeglass temples, friendly to glasses wearers for all-day comfortable wearing experience.

Swivel Folding Portable Structure For Global Travel & Storage

Built with upgraded 180° swivel flat-folding earcup mechanism, the MDR-ZX110AP can be folded into compact mini size easily, saving over 60% storage space compared with non-folding headphones. The rotatable ear cups adapt to different wearing angles, also enabling single-ear monitoring use for commuter road safety. Reinforced durable plastic hinge passes thousands of folding endurance tests, avoiding breakage and looseness during frequent carrying. Comes with 1.2m tangle-free flat audio cord, the optimized cord length fits desktop office, outdoor walking, subway commuting and bedroom leisure use, neither too short to limit movement nor too long to knot randomly. Easy to put into backpacks, handbags, laptop bags and school pencil cases, ultra-portable for business trips, campus daily use, overseas travel and outdoor outing anytime anywhere.

Built-in Omnidirectional Mic & In-Line Remote For Clear Hands-Free Calls

Different from basic music-only headphones, the Sony MDR-ZX110AP adds integrated omnidirectional electret condenser microphone and one-key in-line control module, realizing multifunctional one-handed operation. The upgraded noise-reduction pickup mic filters background wind noise, street noise and ambient chatter effectively, ensuring clear voice transmission for online team meetings, video calls, family voice chat and game team voice communication. The intuitive in-line control button supports one-key answer/hang up calls, play/pause audio, switch previous/next track quickly without touching your mobile device. Fully compatible with Android, iOS, Windows and MacOS mainstream systems, plug-and-play without extra driver installation, stable call performance for daily work communication and social contact.

Universal 3.5mm Plug & Wide Device Compatibility

Featured standard gold-plated 3.5mm TRS audio plug, anti-oxidation and anti-signal-interference design ensures stable audio transmission, reducing plug and play noise and sound interruption. Wide compatibility covers almost all 3.5mm audio port devices: iPhone old models, Android smartphones, iPad, tablet, Windows/Mac laptop, desktop computer, Switch game console, MP3, desktop audio and car audio system. Pure wired connection zero audio latency, superior to Bluetooth headsets for real-time game sound effect synchronization and video audio matching, no Bluetooth pairing failure, no periodic disconnection, no frequent charging troubles, zero-use-threshold for elders, kids and novice users.

Sony Premium Durable Build & Multi-Color Aesthetic Design

Adopting scratch-resistant matte anti-fingerprint body material, the headphone shell resists daily scratch, sweat corrosion and dust stain, keeping new appearance for long-term use. Reinforced cord junction enhances anti-breaking performance, solving common wire fracture problem of budget headphones. Minimalist classic Sony industrial design matches modern daily dressing style, three mainstream colorways: matte black for business office, pure white for youthful campus, dark blue for casual outdoor use, meeting personalized aesthetic demand of global young buyers. Humanized upgrade details: pressure balance head beam, soft buffer ear support, anti-tangle flat wire, all optimized for long-term daily household durable use.

Affordable Clarity And Comfort

For people who make their living on the phone, a comfortable headset makes every call more productive. Stylish and durable, Logitech H570E Headset delivers comfort day after day. Just connect it to a PC or Mac through the USB cable.

Great Value For Great Features

Your Logitech H570E Headset offers premium features at an affordable price. Acoustic echo cancellation, a noise-cancelling mic and digital signal processing (DSP) block out unwanted noise for clear conversations with great sound quality.

Comfortable And Long-lasting

Business people on the phone for hours will enjoy the comfort of this headset. Stylish, lightweight design and durable materials mean you can wear your Logitech H570E Headset all day. Leatherette ear pads, plus padded headband with metal reinforcement provides strength and flexibility, with a fit that feels just right.

Designed For Business

Certifications with leading conference software ensure an integrated experience with applications such as Skype for Business and Cisco Jabber.

No-Look Inline Controls

Control the call with answer/end, volume up/down and mute buttons. A flat and flexible cable resists tangles.

Optimized For Voice And Music

Logitech H570E Headset's dynamic equalizer automatically switches between voice and music modes, delivering the best sound quality for what the user is listening to.

Hear Safely

Logitech Sound Protection protects against sounds above 115 dBA to deliver exceptional listening comfort for voice and music, compliant with EN60950-1.

Enjoy your music as if you were alone, even if you're not, with the Tune 760NC Noise-Canceling Wireless Over-Ear Headphones fromJBL. Active noise cancellation technology takes in distracting ambient noise and filters it out, leaving you immersed in your music or other audio entertainment. With support for multipoint pairing to two devices at the same time, you can be engrossed in a streaming video, but still be able to switch to an incoming call on your smartphone. All of this is powered for days with an extremely long battery life of up to 35 hours with ANC activated.





Quick Charge



If your battery is running low or you're in a rush, you can get up to 2 hours of playback with a quick 5-minute charge.





Foldable Design



The cushioned over-ear earcups are comfortable and provide significant passive noise isolation, but can be cumbersome to store. Thankfully, JBL engineered the Tune 760NC headphones with foldable earcups, making them compact and easy to take with you.





Google Fast Pair



With a compatible Android device, pairing these headphones is a snap. Once you turn them on, your mobile device will give you a notification to pair them. With a tap of the screen the pairing process completes automatically.





Built-In Microphone



With the built-in microphone you can use the Tune 760NC headphones to make hands-free calls when paired with your smartphone. You can also use it to give voice commands to your mobile device's digital assistant.





Wired or Wireless



The included audio cable is an ideal accessory to have when your battery is running low, or you need to connect to non-wireless devices and components.

(>‿◠)✌ SAM AUDIO

OFFICIAL ROSESELSA DEALER - 1 Year Local Warranty & Aftersales Support

Receive within 3 Days - Well packaged from SG warehouse

Responsive reply - We strive to reply within 5 mins

️ Visit Us @ Sim Lim Sqr #01-56, S188504 - Demo units available (Lvl 1 Beside Escalator)

--

ROSESELSA DISTANT MOUNTAIN

> Classic Retro Style Since 1984

> Dulging Into The Beautiful Sound

> Metal Grille & Array Pressure Relief Design

> Comfortable Fit

> Perfect Commute Companion

> RZ200M 3.5 mm to type-C adapter included

--

Descriptions:

> Classic Retro Sytle Since 1984

> Roseselsa presents its product in a high-gloss finish for the first time, recalling of the millenium.

> Lightweight and Breathable

> The sponge ear pads considers both softness and breathability

> Transparent and Communicative, with a Strong Sense of Security.

> The classic headphone architecture sparing the ears more open space, allowing transparency and comfrot to always accompany during wearing. When playback is stopped, you can communicate with the outside with the outside world normally without taking off the headset. Focus on ambient sounds to make commuting and traveling safer.

> Lamskin Headband

> The headbeam is made of solid stainless steel and genuine lambskin, focusing on stable wearing while providing softness and skin-friendliness, which fits well and relieves wearing fatigue.

> Coaxial CNC Machined

> An extraordinary high-end texture. It is the unrivaled choice for a versatile and fashionable must-have.

> 40mm Composite Topological Diaphragm

> Dulging into the beautiful sound. The redesigned dome and corrugated ring deliver crisp transparent treble, and surging profund bass.

> Array Pressure Relieft Design

> The array pressure relieft design on the side of the cavity increases air permeability. At the same time, the air intake is several times that of conventional large-sized headsets, greatly enhancing the treble extension.

> Metal Grille

> Reduces the impact on sound quality from the sound outlet, delivering smoother, stabler treble, and more delcate, fuller tone.

> Fine Length Adjustment

> The headbeam supports fine legnth adjustment, with the clearly visible scale. No more anxiety of left-right symmetry obessive-compulsive disorder.

--

Specifications:

> Impedance: 32Ω ± 15 %

> Sensitivity: 115 ± 3 dB

> Frequency Response Range: 20 ~ 20 kHz

> Total Harmonic Distortion: ≤ 2 % @ 1 kHz

> Wearing Type: On Ear

> Diaphragm Driver Diameter: 40 mm

> Connector Type: MMCX

> Cable Length: 120 cm

> RZ200M 3.5 mm to type-C adapter

--

13727085452.title: QCY | QCY H3 ANC Hi-Res Audio Wireless Bluetooth 5.4 Headphones Over Ear Headset 60Hrs 43dB Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation Earphone
13727085452.detail_text: QCY H3 ANC Hi-Res Audio Wireless Bluetooth 5.4 Headphones Over Ear Headset 60Hrs 43dB Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation Earphone 43dB Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation With hybrid anc technology,the five microphones work together to block noise up to 43dB.Four adjustable settings for every noisy situation. Bimodal Ear Canal Adaptive Audio Compensation Headset to detect ear-canal structure and the way people wear it and create exclusive noise canceling parameters to revise audio curve that it can deliver same yet premium listening to different people.( Note: This function needs to be turned on manually every time you use it, it cannot be fully self-adapted in real time.) VDCNN for Clear Calls Packed with Very Deep Convolutional Neural Networks(VDCNN) technology, the microphones can sense different environments and auto adjust noise canceling level accordingly so you can always enjoy stable, natural and quality calls indoors or outdoors. Hi-Res Audio Original HD Sound 40kHz frequency response delivers CD-quality sound.Hi-Res Audio provides extraordinary clarity and detail.40mm Composite-Diaphragm with Titanium Plating offer cinema-level 3D sound,high resolution with punchy bass and transparent highs. Note:mid- and high-frequency sound quality can be improved by upgrading the firmware on the QCY APP! Transparency Mode Hear the ambient sound clearly while still enjoying the music. Be aware of surroundings when you are shopping/walking/chatting. Connect to 2 Devices It supports simultaneous connection of two Bluetooth devices, allowing you to enjoy work and entertainment at the same time. 60 hour Extra-long Battery life With ANC off, enjoy about 60 hours of playback,turn on ANC, there are 35 hours of playback. 1.5h Charging time=60h Music time=300h Standby time. Wireless Bluetooth 5.4/Wired Mode Advanced Bluetooth 5.4 chip provides a fast and stable full-link transmission. You can easily switch between bluetooth 5.4 and 3.5mm AUX cable.These 2 configurations grant you the versatility to get the most out of all devices.( 3.5mm AUX Cable included) Gaming Mode In gaming mode, 0.068s low latency allow you enjoy a better gaming experience. Soft Ear Pads,Unprecedented Comfort Synthetic protein leather ear pads combine with slow spring memory foam for exceptional wearability with less pressure on your ears. It's so comfortable that you don't need to take a break from your favourite music. Smart APP QCY APP supports pairing, EQ and customizable noise canceling level. Now it's your time to explore more in the APP and build your own headset. Button control, easy to operation, support Voice Assistant. Notice for using wired mode: When your QCY H3 using our 3.5mm cable (i.e. wired mode is on) , the headset is in close mode and only supports audio output. The Bluetooth function (ANC, EQ, etc.) and microphone unable to be used. If you need to use related functions, please switch to wireless mode and confirm the Bluetooth was connected. 43dB Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation

With hybrid anc technology,the five microphones work together to block noise up to 43dB.Four adjustable settings for every noisy situation.

Bimodal Ear Canal Adaptive Audio Compensation

Headset to detect ear-canal structure and the way people wear it and create exclusive noise canceling parameters to revise audio curve that it can deliver same yet premium listening to different people.(Note: This function needs to be turned on manually every time you use it, it cannot be fully self-adapted in real time.)

VDCNN for Clear Calls

Packed with Very Deep Convolutional Neural Networks(VDCNN) technology, the microphones can sense different environments and auto adjust noise canceling level accordingly so you can always enjoy stable, natural and quality calls indoors or outdoors.

Hi-Res Audio Original HD Sound

40kHz frequency response delivers CD-quality sound.Hi-Res Audio provides extraordinary clarity and detail.40mm Composite-Diaphragm with Titanium Plating offer cinema-level 3D sound,high resolution with punchy bass and transparent highs.

Note:mid- and high-frequency sound quality can be improved by upgrading the firmware on the QCY APP!

Transparency Mode

Hear the ambient sound clearly while still enjoying the music. Be aware of surroundings when you are shopping/walking/chatting.

Connect to 2 Devices

It supports simultaneous connection of two Bluetooth devices, allowing you to enjoy work and entertainment at the same time.

60 hour Extra-long Battery life

With ANC off, enjoy about 60 hours of playback,turn on ANC, there are 35 hours of playback. 1.5h Charging time=60h Music time=300h Standby time.

Wireless Bluetooth 5.4/Wired Mode

Advanced Bluetooth 5.4 chip provides a fast and stable full-link transmission. You can easily switch between bluetooth 5.4 and 3.5mm AUX cable.These 2 configurations grant you the versatility to get the most out of all devices.( 3.5mm AUX Cable included)

Gaming Mode

In gaming mode, 0.068s low latency allow you enjoy a better gaming experience.

Soft Ear Pads,Unprecedented Comfort

Synthetic protein leather ear pads combine with slow spring memory foam for exceptional wearability with less pressure on your ears.

It's so comfortable that you don't need to take a break from your favourite music.

Smart APP

QCY APP supports pairing, EQ and customizable noise canceling level. Now it's your time to explore more in the APP and build your own headset.

Button control, easy to operation, support Voice Assistant.


Notice for using wired mode:

When your QCY H3 using our 3.5mm cable (i.e. wired mode is on), the headset is in close mode and only supports audio output. The Bluetooth function (ANC, EQ, etc.) and microphone unable to be used.

If you need to use related functions, please switch to wireless mode and confirm the Bluetooth was connected.

Operation range: 10m
Playback time: approx. 60/35hr(ANC OFF/ON)

Charging time: About 2hr

Earbud size: 160.2*81.7*196.8mm

Contents

Headset * 1;  Type-C cable * 1;  Audio cable * 1; User manual * 1

Sound quality increased by 50%? Do it!

Tips: Upgrade the firmware in QCY APP, and the sound quality can be improved by an additional 50%. The upgraded headphones will have richer and more powerful low frequencies and clearer mid and high frequencies.



FAQ:

Q:Does H3 Hi-Res support wired mode or wireless mode?
A:Hi-Res is only supported by wired headphones, but not in wireless mode. Our current Hi-Res is a wired version, and we plan to add a wireless version to subsequent new models.


Q:Can the mid- and high-frequency sound quality be improved by upgrading the firmware on the QCY APP?
A:Yes, by upgrading the APP, you can upgrade the sound quality.


Q:Can active noise reduction be turned on in wired mode?
A: Active noise reduction cannot be turned on in wired mode, only wireless mode supports it.
 

Note:

1. 43dB in-depth noise canceling is achieved by ANC and PNC working together, which is measured by Hele Acoustic Lab.

2. Adaptive noise canceling can only be turned on in ANC ON mode and these two functions will work together.

3. Please refer to user manual to download QCY App before you can switch among noise canceling modes and adjust the level.

   Boosted mode is the default and any mode change will be remained when you power on the headset again.

4. Press ANC Button to switch mode and you’ll hear voice prompt accordingly.

5. For Android users we recommend you to select SBC in developer options before you use Gaming Mode.

6. Please refer user manual to download the App which requires android 8.0 or above/iOS 13.0 or above.

   Pairing requires Android system. Please open qcy APP and turn on Bluetooth on phone before use it.

◎ Monster Harmonic N21 ↓

Monster Harmonic N21 wireless over‑ear headphones feature Bluetooth 6.0, a 40mm dynamic driver, and dual EQ modes for punchy bass or clear vocals. With up to 25 hours of battery, foldable compact design, soft protein earpads, clear call noise reduction, and universal compatibility—ideal for daily music, calls, and travel.

Built with an upgraded Bluetooth 6.0 chip for faster, more stable connections. Instant pairing, zero lag, quicker transmission, lower power draw, and reduced latency, total performance maxed out.

◎40mm Large Dynamic Driver↓

Equipped with a massive 40mm diaphragm for thunderous, impactful bass that delivers stunning sonic punch. Crisp, transparent mids and highs create an immersive, concert-like audio experience.

◎Dual EQ Sound Modes↓

Switch between two custom-tuned EQ modes: Bass Mode and Vocal Mode. Experience powerful, punchy bass or crystal-clear, pristine vocals all with a single tap.

◎Long-Lasting Endurance↓

Powered by a high-capacity 300mAh battery for up to 25 hours of non-stop music playback. Small but mighty, it keeps you powered all day long.

◎Foldable & Compact Design↓

Upgraded ultracompact build with flexible foldable structure for easy storage. Folds down to a mini size that fits effortlessly into your bag, saving space at home or on the go.

◎Crystal-Clear Calls↓

Equipped with high-sensitivity microphones that actively suppress ambient noise and precisely enhance your voice. Enjoy interruption-free conversations even in noisy environments—just like talking face-to-face.

◎Universal Compatibility↓

Fully compatible with major systems including Android ,iOS and Wins. Works seamlessly with mobile phones, tablets, laptop and other Bluetooth-enabled devices for maximum flexibility in daily use.

◎All-Day Comfort Wear↓

◎Easy Control↓

Intuitive button controls let you easily play, pause, and switch tracks/EQ with a simple click. Put complete music control right at your fingertips.

●Power Button

- Single tap: Volume up/Volume down

- Connect 3.5mm audio cable for wired listening, lower latency & power saving
